name: Corton
rightsHistoryPurpose: Official filiation, dated legal-entity rights and original-reference evidence for Corton (#461). None establishes current farming.

reviewedUncoveredArea.note: The measured 8251.295167 m² remainder (0.5139%) was reviewed against the pinned INAO boundary and Aloxe-Corton and Pernand-Vergelesses and Ladoix-Serrigny cadastres. The cru outline has 18 separate parts on the hill across Aloxe-Corton, Ladoix-Serrigny and Pernand-Vergelesses; the remainder is narrow strips between the official line and the nearest cadastral parcels. It forms 68 pieces, with mean widths of 0.07–1.22 m for those of at least 1 m². 105.099365 m² lies between parcels inside the outline and the rest along its edge. It is not a missing INAO commune. 8251.295167 m² is covered by no audited parcel. No geometry is added, clipped, buffered or filled. The absolute cap allows less than 0.1 m² above this reviewed measurement; changed source hashes require another review.

namedPlots.coverageNote: The official wine-board list names 25 Corton climats, and all match cadastral lieux-dits in Aloxe-Corton, Ladoix-Serrigny or Pernand-Vergelesses. The village maps already show Corton's climats as official INAO denominations, so this cadastral audit adds no second layer and the official outlines are retained; producer holdings are not shown.

reviewedOverlaps.note: The pinned cadastral lieux-dits EN CHARLEMAGNE (Ladoix-Serrigny) and LE CHARLEMAGNE (Aloxe-Corton) overlap by 83.365 m² inside the cru along the commune line. Both outlines are kept exactly as published; neither is clipped, and the overlap assigns no parcel to both.
